signal: Unchanged baseline: median peer 15-minute decline <= -0.003, >=70% peers declining, target also declining; subsequent 10-minute peer recovery >= half decline magnitude; peer recovery minus stock recovery >=0.003 and stock last five-minute close positive; next bar open entry, 30-minute time exit, 40-minute per-stock signal cooldown; original screen k=6..59.
portfolio: Unchanged exploratory replay now fixed before extended results: stop at minimum low of five completed bars before entry minus $0.01; no entry if stop>=entry; stop or 30-minute exit; gap-through exit at worse open. Maximum two simultaneous positions, one per group; rank simultaneous signals by residual descending then symbol. Whole shares, 25% realized equity notional cap, 0.25% planned account risk including costs. $2,500 starting equity. Costs 0/5/10/20 bps round trip.
evaluation: Report every cost, year and reserved period. Event means and peer excess; five-session block bootstrap preserving same-day events; finite-capital return and EOD drawdown. Do not optimize based on reserved outcomes. These are research simulations, not live fills or performance promises.
execution_diagnostic: If feasible, query first historical SIP bid/ask after selected event entries/exits, using deterministic date-stratified sampling; assess spreads and deviation from bar-open prices. Do not infer fills from quotes alone.
authorization: Research and market data only; no trading orders, account mutations, subscriptions or funding.
